title: Optimal randomized truthful two-facility location
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: Determine the optimal worst-case expected social-cost approximation ratio of truthful-in-expectation two-facility mechanisms on the real line without payments.
definitions: For each n≥1, a mechanism maps every reported vector x∈R^n measurably to a probability distribution over pairs (y_1,y_2)∈R²; co-located facilities and locations not equal to reports are allowed. Agent i with true position x_i incurs d(x_i;y)=min{|x_i−y_1|,|x_i−y_2|}. Require finite expected individual costs at every profile. Truthfulness in expectation means for all i,x and alternative report z∈R, E[d(x_i;M_n(x))]≤E[d(x_i;M_n(z,x_−i))]. Other agents’ reports are fixed and the expectation is only over mechanism randomness. There are no payments, anonymity or computational restrictions. Let SC(x;y)=∑_i d(x_i;y) and OPT(x)=min_{y∈R²}SC(x;y). Define R_2 as the infimum of c≥1 for which there is a family (M_n) for all n with E[SC(x;M_n(x))]≤c OPT(x) for every n,x. This inequality requires zero expected cost when OPT=0, rather than discarding those instances.
answer_criterion: Supply a real approximation a to the defined optimal constant and a complete Lean-checked proof of absolute error at most 1/100. A certified interval of width at most 1/50 qualifies via its midpoint. Exact identification is welcome but not required; an infimum or supremum need not be attained.
context: The 2026 result improves the classical factor-four benchmark but does not identify the unrestricted optimal ratio for the line.
why: The sharp ratio would quantify the efficiency cost of truthful location reporting for multiple public facilities.

import_provenance.original_statement: What is the smallest worst-case expected social-cost approximation ratio achievable by a truthful-in-expectation mechanism placing two facilities on the real line without payments? Agents privately report their locations, each incurs distance to the nearer facility, and social cost is the sum of these distances.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial sharp-ratio target in their foundational model. The 2026 preprint improves the upper bound from 4 to approximately 3.519, including the line, but does not identify the optimal ratio.

sentences: The mechanism places two facilities and pays no transfers.
Each agent cares about distance to its closer facility.
Truthfulness is measured in expectation over the mechanism’s randomness.
The optimum ratio includes all agent counts and all zero-cost instances.
